data.narrative:
Volund Manufacturing is a Seed-stage defense and security company that has raised $12M to date. The company's leadership includes founders with relevant prior experience across defense contractors (Anduril, Aerojet Rocketdyne, Blue Origin) and consumer hardware (Apple, Oakley). The valuation peer set comprises 10 comparable companies—2 public and 8 private—anchored by same-sector, same-stage businesses including UFORCE ($1.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M).

Two triangulation methods yield actionable ranges. The stage-progression method applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier to the $12M raised proxy, implying a $30M valuation. The peer-median approach cites three Defense & Security comparables at Seed or Series A stage, with a median valuation of $400M and a range spanning $125M to $1.0B. These methods diverge substantially, reflecting the wide dispersion in defensibility and market timing across early-stage defense-tech entrants.

Synthesizing both approaches yields a triangulated range of $26M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $215M. The wide spread reflects two material uncertainties: first, whether Volund's technology and go-to-market approach will justify valuations near sector medians or regress toward the lower bound; second, capital availability in the defense-tech market through the next funding event. The Seed-stage stage and limited public financials constrain confidence in any single point estimate.
